modalities.evidence: structural and functional MRI data collected from 24 participants
Functional data consisted of T2*-weighted multi-band echo-planar imaging sequences

output.summary: Structural and functional MRI from 24 participants on a 3T Siemens Skyra, with partial-volume functional runs covering hippocampus, temporal and occipital lobes, supporting a study of predictive cue-action-outcome learning.
